subject: The one mistake 90% of dog owners make at dinner
preview_text: It adds hundreds of hidden calories every week. Here's the simple 60-second fix I discovered.
body_paragraphs: I watched my dog, Scout, lick his empty bowl for the third time. I felt that familiar pang of guilt. Was he still hungry? Was I starving him? So I'd give him a little extra. Just a scoop. That one tiny, well-meaning mistake was secretly undoing all our progress.

Here's the truth nobody tells you: that 'little extra' is the silent saboteur. It's not the big treats or the skipped walks. It's the unmeasured handfuls. Those extra kibbles add up to hundreds of hidden calories a week, enough to stall any weight loss plan completely. The fix is embarrassingly simple and takes less than a minute.

This is exactly why the Calorie Calculator in PupShape exists. Don't just pour food. For the next three days, use it to log every single meal and treat. You'll see the real numbers. It's like turning on the lights in a dark room—suddenly, you can see exactly what's going in the bowl.

Open PupShape right now and tap the Calorie Calculator. Log today's dinner. Just do it once. You'll know the exact number, and that knowledge is power. P.S. The dogs who do this for one week see a noticeable difference in their energy levels. It's that powerful.
